sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 NYTimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, in 2001, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 2001 年的今天，美国

sentences.en: granted temporary protected status to the people of El Salvador after a pair of deadly earthquakes ravaged the country.
sentences.zh: 在萨尔瓦多遭遇两次致命地震重创后，给予了该国人民临时保护身份。

sentences.en: Almost 20 years later, that temporary status seemed permanent until the Trump administration announced it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 近 20 年后，这种临时身份看起来似乎变成了永久性的，直到特朗普政府宣布并非如此。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, January 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 1 月 9 日，星期二。

sentences.en: In the 1980s, El Salvador was facing a civil war.
sentences.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代，萨尔瓦多正面临内战。

sentences.en: Basically, leftist guerrillas, or people who were sort of considered leftist guerrillas, were fighting against a military-controlled government.
sentences.zh: 基本上，左翼游击队，或者说被认为是左翼游击队的人，正在与军方控制的政府作战。

sentences.en: Ozzam Ahmed reports on Central America for The Times.
sentences.zh: 奥扎姆·艾哈迈德为《时报》报道中美洲新闻。

sentences.en: It was a really brutal civil war.
sentences.zh: 那是一场非常残酷的内战。

sentences.en: We're talking 75,000 people killed over the course of 12 years.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是在 12 年间有 7.5 万人丧生。

sentences.en: During which time, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，美国

sentences.en: provided a substantial sum of money to the government-slash-military of El Salvador to fight this war.
sentences.zh: 向萨尔瓦多的政府兼军方提供了巨额资金来打这场仗。

sentences.en: At the end of it, the United Nations did a report on what they found, and they found that 95% of the killings were the responsibility of the U.S.-backed government.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，联合国对此进行了调查并发布报告，发现 95% 的杀戮行为是由美国支持的政府造成的。

sentences.en: Too many have thought of Central America as just that place way down below Mexico that can't possibly constitute a threat to our well-being.
sentences.zh: 太多人认为中美洲只是墨西哥下方那个遥远的地方，不可能对我们的福祉构成威胁。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: was looking at the examples of Nicaragua and Cuba, and the Salvadoran government was very skilled at positing the leftists as communists.
sentences.zh: 当时正在审视尼加拉瓜和古巴的例子，而萨尔瓦多政府非常擅长将左翼分子定性为共产主义者。

sentences.en: And so, not wanting to see another domino fall, the U.S.-backed government, including Jimmy Carter, the Democratic president at the time, began giving money.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了不让另一块多米诺骨牌倒下，包括时任民主党总统吉米·卡特在内的美国政府开始提供资金。

sentences.en: Of course, that money got ramped up under Reagan.
sentences.zh: 当然，这笔资金在里根执政期间进一步增加了。

sentences.en: Central America's problems do directly affect the security and the well-being of our own people.
sentences.zh: 中美洲的问题确实直接影响到我们本国人民的安全和福祉。

sentences.en: And Central America is much closer to the United States than many of the world trouble spots that concern us.
sentences.zh: 而且中美洲比许多令我们担忧的世界动荡地区更接近美国。

sentences.en: So, we work to restore our own economy.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们致力于恢复自己的经济。

sentences.en: We cannot afford to lose sight of our neighbors to the south.
sentences.zh: 我们不能忽视南方的邻居。

sentences.en: El Salvador is nearer to Texas than Texas is to Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多离德克萨斯的距离比德克萨斯离马萨诸塞还要近。

sentences.en: Nicaragua is just as close to Miami, San Antonio, San Diego, and Tucson as those cities are to Washington, where we're gathered tonight.
sentences.zh: 尼加拉瓜离迈阿密、圣安东尼奥、圣地亚哥和图森的距离，和这些城市到我们今晚聚集的华盛顿的距离一样近。

sentences.en: So, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，美国

sentences.en: saw this as a battle in the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 将此视为冷战中的一场战斗。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it chose the side of the Salvadoran government against what it saw as a potential communist enemy claiming yet another country in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 它选择了站在萨尔瓦多政府一边，对抗它所认为的潜在共产主义敌人，因为对方声称要在拉丁美洲夺取另一个国家。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And it cost the American taxpayer $5 billion, money invested to ensure that the Salvadoran regime would triumph over the guerrillas.
sentences.zh: 这花费了美国纳税人 50 亿美元，这些钱投入进去是为了确保萨尔瓦多政权能够战胜游击队。

sentences.en: But a new study for the Pentagon says American policy was based on false assumptions and failed.
sentences.zh: 但五角大楼的一项新研究称，美国的政策基于错误的假设，最终失败了。

sentences.en: So, how did it come to be that so many Salvadorans were allowed to come to the United States during this time?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么在那段时间里，有这么多萨尔瓦多人被允许进入美国呢？

sentences.en: So, one of the interesting dynamics that was playing out amid the Civil War was the United States passed the Immigration Act of 1990.
sentences.zh: 内战期间发生的一个有趣的动态是，美国通过了《1990 年移民法》。

sentences.en: The provision of that was TPS, this Temporary Protected Status.
sentences.zh: 其中的条款就是 TPS，即临时保护身份。

sentences.en: And El Salvador was one of the first beneficiaries of that.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多是该政策的首批受益者之一。

sentences.en: People from 1990, ultimately through 1994, were able to flee the country and come in under that Temporary Protected Status.
sentences.zh: 从 1990 年到 1994 年，人们得以逃离该国，并以临时保护身份进入美国。

sentences.en: Some get jobs, start families, prosper.
sentences.zh: 有些人找到了工作，组建了家庭，过上了好日子。

sentences.en: Others who are trapped in sort of a cycle of poverty find themselves face-to-face with other minorities, sort of trapped on the edges of the American dream.
sentences.zh: 而另一些陷入贫困循环的人，发现自己不得不面对其他少数族裔，被困在美国梦的边缘。

sentences.en: And they found that they had to defend themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们发现自己必须进行自卫。

sentences.en: In El Salvador, they fight against each other.
sentences.zh: 在萨尔瓦多，他们互相残杀。

sentences.en: But in Los Angeles, they stand side by side on street corners, hoping to find a day's work.
sentences.zh: 但在洛杉矶，他们并肩站在街角，希望能找到一份零工。

sentences.en: Veterans of the Salvadoran military and supporters of leftist rebels seeking to overthrow the government, forced together by circumstances.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多军队的退伍军人和寻求推翻政府的左翼叛军支持者，因环境所迫走到了一起。

sentences.en: All refugees who've managed to leave their country and its nine-year-old civil war behind.
sentences.zh: 他们都是设法逃离了祖国及其九年内战的难民。

sentences.en: You know, many of these communities settled around L.A.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些社区大多在洛杉矶周边定居。

sentences.en: And at that time, there was a gang problem in L.A.
sentences.zh: 当时，洛杉矶存在帮派问题。

sentences.en: So the Salvadoran community, the youth, formed these groups of gangs to defend themselves from other minority groups.
sentences.zh: 因此，萨尔瓦多社区的年轻人组建了这些帮派，以保护自己免受其他少数族裔团体的侵害。

sentences.en: I got shot through this side, and it came out through this side.
sentences.zh: 我这一侧中弹，子弹从另一侧穿了出来。

sentences.en: And it messed up my bone and my veins.
sentences.zh: 它弄坏了我的骨头和血管。

sentences.en: I can't even walk the streets now, because if you're going to walk the streets, you're going to carry something with you.
sentences.zh: 我现在甚至不敢走在街上，因为如果你要走在街上，你就得随身带点什么。

sentences.en: I don't think, you know, that I'll live to see 23.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是否能活到 23 岁。

sentences.en: As the years progressed, these groups became increasingly violent and criminalized.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，这些团体的暴力和犯罪倾向日益严重。

sentences.en: And, in fact, MS-13 and Barrio 18, or the 18th Street Gang, formed in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 事实上，MS-13 和 Barrio 18（即 18 街帮）就是在洛杉矶形成的。

sentences.en: You've got to fight for your varro.
sentences.zh: 你必须为你的街区而战。

sentences.en: Sometimes you've got to kill for your varro.
sentences.zh: 有时你必须为了你的街区去杀人。

sentences.en: Just to keep up your reputation.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是为了维持你的名声。

sentences.en: Raise your right on.
sentences.zh: 举起你的右手。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: immigration officials inspect and photograph the elaborate tattoos of a Mara Salvatrucha gang member.
sentences.zh: 移民官员正在检查并拍摄一名“萨尔瓦多游击队”帮派成员身上复杂的纹身。

sentences.en: He's one of 582 men arrested in recent days, 26 in Los Angeles alone.
sentences.zh: 他是最近几天被捕的 582 人之一，仅在洛杉矶就有 26 人。

sentences.en: It's all part of a continuing crackdown by U.S.
sentences.zh: 这都是美国持续打击行动的一部分。

sentences.en: Homeland Security forces targeting illegal immigrants from violent street gangs.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部队的目标是来自暴力街头帮派的非法移民。

sentences.en: So, during the 90s, as the gangs in Los Angeles, the Salvadoran gangs in Los Angeles, are sort of growing into broader organized criminal enterprises,
sentences.zh: 所以，在 90 年代，随着洛杉矶的萨尔瓦多帮派逐渐发展成更广泛的有组织犯罪企业，

sentences.en: the United States starts arresting and convicting many of these guys and finding out, oh, these guys aren't even American.
sentences.zh: 美国开始逮捕并定罪其中许多人，然后发现，哦，这些人甚至不是美国人。

sentences.en: And so they begin deporting them.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始将这些人驱逐出境。

sentences.en: This government video shows some of the arrestees getting on a plane, being deported.
sentences.zh: 这段政府视频显示了一些被捕者正在登机，被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: In this case, back to El Salvador, and leaving the plane free of handcuffs and leg chains.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们被送回萨尔瓦多，下飞机时没有戴手铐和脚镣。

sentences.en: And remember, they're deporting them to a country that is in an extraordinarily fragile state.
sentences.zh: 记住，他们被驱逐回的是一个处于极其脆弱状态的国家。

sentences.en: This country's just come out of the Civil War, so no one really has any idea what's in store for them when suddenly these guys who have been organized in the streets of L.A.
sentences.zh: 这个国家刚刚走出内战，所以当这些在洛杉矶街头组织起来的人突然降落在一个几乎没有正常运作政府的国家时，没人知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: land in a country that barely has a functioning government.
sentences.zh: 在萨尔瓦多，他们开始壮大。

sentences.en: And in Salvador, they begin to flourish.
sentences.zh: 国家警察估计该国有约 6 万名帮派成员在活动。

sentences.en: The National Police estimates some 60,000 gang members operate in the country.
sentences.zh: 他们最初是由从南加州返回的被驱逐者建立的，这些萨尔瓦多人曾加入过洛杉矶臭名昭著的街头帮派，

sentences.en: They were originally founded by returning deportees from Southern California, Salvadorans who had joined some of the notorious street gangs of Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 并在被迫返回祖国时，创办了自己的组织。

sentences.en: and who started their own organizations when they were forced to return to their home country.
sentences.zh: 有很多孤儿，他们的父母在战争中丧生，现在和祖父母住在一起，这些孩子没有任何其他经济来源。

sentences.en: There are a lot of orphaned children whose parents died during the war, who are living with their grandparents, kids who have no other source of support.
sentences.zh: 而帮派为他们提供了这些。

sentences.en: And the gangs provide that for them.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始慢慢组织起来。

sentences.en: So they begin to slowly organize.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多陷入了危机。

sentences.en: And in El Salvador, there's a crisis.
sentences.zh: 这太令人着迷了。

sentences.en: So this is fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这些帮派成员因为内战获得了美国的保护身份，从而在美国成为了帮派成员，

sentences.en: These gang members who have become gang members in the United States as a result of receiving this protected status from the United States because of the Civil War,
sentences.zh: 他们回到萨尔瓦多，填补了内战留下的制度和政府真空。

sentences.en: they return to El Salvador and sort of fill a void of institutions and government left by the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's totally right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上，这个问题是在美国制造的，然后又出口回了萨尔瓦多。

sentences.en: I mean, basically, that problem got created in the United States and then exported back to El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 你花了很多时间在萨尔瓦多进行报道。

sentences.en: So you've spent a lot of time reporting in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 你能为我们描述一下，由于这些帮派在那里形成，那里的生活变成了什么样子吗？

sentences.en: Can you describe for us what life has become like there as a result of these gangs being formed there?
sentences.zh: 这些帮派对这个国家有什么样的控制力？

sentences.en: What sort of hold do these gangs have on the country?
sentences.zh: 很大程度上，这是一种经济上的扼杀。

sentences.en: Largely, it is an economic chokehold.
sentences.zh: 帮派靠勒索生存。

sentences.en: The gangs survive on extortion.
sentences.zh: 他们从事的毒品交易规模很小。

sentences.en: And what drug trade they do, it's small.
sentences.zh: 当你提到勒索时，你指的是什么？

sentences.en: And when you say extortion, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，帮派成员会告诉公交车司机，如果你想穿过我们的地盘并让乘客下车，你就必须每天付给我们 5 美元、10 美元，不管勒索金额是多少，

sentences.en: So I mean, gang members will tell bus drivers, if you want to drive through our territory and drop people off, you have to pay us $5 a day, $10 a day, whatever the extortion is,
sentences.zh: 虽然金额很小。

sentences.en: but it's small.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉店主，如果你想在我们的社区经营，就必须每天付给我们 5 美元。

sentences.en: They'll tell store owners, if you want to operate in our neighborhoods, you have to pay us $5 a day.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉送货卡车司机，哦，你想在我们的社区卖可乐，可口可乐，你就得交一笔费用。

sentences.en: They'll tell delivery truck drivers, oh, you want to sell Coke in our neighborhood, Coca-Cola, you're going to have to pay a fee.
sentences.zh: 所以起初，这就像一群孩子聚在一起。

sentences.en: So at first, it's just like a bunch of kids hanging out.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间他们变得更有组织，开始勒索民众。

sentences.en: And then suddenly they get more organized and suddenly they start extorting populations.
sentences.zh: 于是政府开始了他们所谓的“铁腕政策”。

sentences.en: And so the government begins what they call the mano dura.
sentences.zh: Mano 意为手，dura 意为强硬。

sentences.en: Mano, which means hand, dura, means the strong hand.
sentences.zh: 但我们通常将其翻译为“铁拳”，这是一种焦土政策。

sentences.en: But loosely we sort of translate it as the iron fist, which is a scorched earth policy.
sentences.zh: 他们开始大规模地围捕这些人，采取极度暴力的手段试图清理街道。

sentences.en: They begin rounding up these guys in mass, hyperviolent tactics to try and clear the streets.
sentences.zh: 而这种打击行动实际上迫使帮派变得更加纪律严明、组织有序。

sentences.en: And that crackdown actually forces the gangs to become more disciplined, better organized.
sentences.zh: 进入 21 世纪，政府继续采取同样的方法。

sentences.en: And so into the 2000s, the government kind of continues with the same approach.
sentences.zh: 但这除了巩固帮派及其在萨尔瓦多这些边缘社区的地位外，毫无作用。

sentences.en: And it did nothing but sort of fortify the gangs and their position in these marginal neighborhoods inside of El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 所以在萨尔瓦多的许多地区，帮派听起来像是事实上的政府？

sentences.en: So in many areas of El Salvador, are the gangs, it sounds like kind of the de facto government?
sentences.zh: 他们绝对是。

sentences.en: They absolutely are.
sentences.zh: 这与叛乱的相似之处很有趣。

sentences.en: It's interesting in the parallels to an insurgency.
sentences.zh: 如果你进入一个由叛乱分子控制的地区，你经常会发现当地民众，

sentences.en: If you go into an area controlled by insurgency, you often find the population,
sentences.zh: 即使不是完全支持叛乱，至少也有一种心态，那就是政府才是敌人。

sentences.en: if not totally supportive of the insurgency, then at least of a mindset that it's the government that's the enemy.
sentences.zh: 因为是政府进来开枪，是政府进来逮捕人。

sentences.en: Because it's the government that comes in and fires shots, the government that comes in and arrests people.
sentences.zh: 是政府在制定法律。

sentences.en: It's the government that sort of lays down the law.
sentences.zh: 我在萨尔瓦多也发现了同样的情况。

sentences.en: And I found the same thing in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 我走进这些社区，没有人喜欢帮派。

sentences.en: I go into these neighborhoods and nobody loved the gangs.
sentences.zh: 人们容忍帮派。

sentences.en: People tolerated the gangs.
sentences.zh: 他们提供了一种秩序的假象。

sentences.en: They offered some semblance of order.
sentences.zh: 如果你在某些社区不与他们发生纠葛，至少你还是安全的。

sentences.en: And if you didn't involve yourself with them largely in some neighborhoods, at least you were okay.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们认为，特别是在政府过去 15 年里实施的各种“铁拳”时刻，

sentences.en: And instead, what they viewed, especially during these various sort of iron fist moments that the government has exercised over the last 15 years,
sentences.zh: 他们觉得警察才是敌人。

sentences.en: they feel like the police are the enemy.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多似乎正走向成为“坟墓之国”。

sentences.en: It seems El Salvador is headed to become the country of graves.
sentences.zh: 根据警方统计，在 1 月和 2 月期间，几乎每小时就有一人死于暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: According to police statistics, during the months of January and February, one person has died of a violent crime almost every hour.
sentences.zh: 是什么导致萨尔瓦多现在拥有“世界上凶杀率最高国家”这一可怕的称号？

sentences.en: What explains the fact that El Salvador now has this awful distinction of being the country with the highest homicide rate in the world?
sentences.zh: 是帮派暴力吗？

sentences.en: Is it gang violence?
sentences.zh: 是政府暴力吗？

sentences.en: Is it government violence?
sentences.zh: 还是两者的某种结合？

sentences.en: Or is it some combination of the two?
sentences.zh: 越来越像是两者的结合。

sentences.en: Increasingly, it's a combination of the two.
sentences.zh: 你所看到的是，警察被赋予了极大的自由去攻击和杀害帮派成员。

sentences.en: What you've seen is the police have been given a very free hand to attack and kill gang members.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，内政部长曾在公开场合表示，基本上没有警察会因为开枪而受到追究。

sentences.en: I mean, the Minister of Interior has said on the record, like, no police officer will be held to account for firing his weapon, essentially.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 这是对帮派成员的公开猎杀。

sentences.en: It's open season on gang members.
sentences.zh: 是警察在杀害帮派成员。

sentences.en: It's the police killing gang members.
sentences.zh: 是帮派成员在杀害警察。

sentences.en: It's the gang members killing police.
sentences.zh: 绝对是帮派成员为了地盘，为了这些家伙能凑到的那点钱而互相残杀。

sentences.en: It's absolutely gang members fighting gang members for territory, for what little money these guys can pull together.
sentences.zh: 这是一场多线战争。

sentences.en: It's a multi-front war.
sentences.zh: 他们在互相残杀。

sentences.en: They're fighting each other.
sentences.zh: 他们在与警察作战。

sentences.en: They're fighting the police.
sentences.zh: 警察在与他们所有人作战，这最终造成了这些惊人的统计数据。

sentences.en: The police are fighting all of them, which ultimately creates these kinds of staggering statistics.
sentences.zh: 而且你谈论的还是一个小国。

sentences.en: And you're also talking about a small country.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是一个只有 600 多万人口的国家。

sentences.en: We're talking about a country that's a little over 6 million people.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是成千上万的帮派成员，以及更多依靠这种特定企业带来的经济生存的人。

sentences.en: We're talking about tens of thousands of gang members and many more tens of thousands of people who rely on the economics that that particular enterprise brings.
sentences.zh: 在一个拥有世界上最高凶杀率的国家，实际情况是什么样的？

sentences.en: What does it actually look like in a country with the highest homicide rate in the world?
sentences.zh: 那里的暴力在日常生活中是什么样的？

sentences.en: What is that violence like there day to day?
sentences.zh: 暴力往往是突然且突兀的。

sentences.en: The violence is sort of sudden and abrupt.
sentences.zh: 暴力往往是突然且突兀的。

sentences.en: I mean, there's parts of El Salvador where life goes on as normal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，萨尔瓦多有些地方的生活依然如常。

sentences.en: People still go to work, get married, have kids, celebrate on the weekends.
sentences.zh: 人们照常上班、结婚、生子，周末也会庆祝。

sentences.en: And yet in certain pockets of it, almost every day, someone's being killed.
sentences.zh: 然而在某些区域，几乎每天都有人被杀。

sentences.en: Either it's a gang shooting in a market because a vendor didn't pay extortion payment.
sentences.zh: 要么是因为小贩没交保护费而引发的帮派市场枪击案。

sentences.en: Or it is a shootout between rivals for territory.
sentences.zh: 要么是敌对帮派为了争夺地盘而火拼。

sentences.en: Or it's a targeted assassination of a gang leader.
sentences.zh: 又或者是针对帮派头目的暗杀。

sentences.en: These things are still diffuse.
sentences.zh: 这些情况依然是零星分散的。

sentences.en: Certain neighborhoods heat up and there's a lot of violence at once.
sentences.zh: 某些街区会突然变得紧张，短时间内暴力事件频发。

sentences.en: But, I mean, you can go to El Salvador for a week and witness nothing.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，你可以在萨尔瓦多待上一周，却什么也没看到。

sentences.en: But there's a sense of menace in a lot of these communities.
sentences.zh: 不过在许多社区里，确实弥漫着一种威胁感。

sentences.en: There's a sense of pervasive fear.
sentences.zh: 有一种无处不在的恐惧感。

sentences.en: So, one night, I'm hanging out in a neighborhood and we hear gunshots and suddenly six kids run by carrying weapons.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，我在一个街区闲逛，我们听到了枪声，突然有六个孩子带着武器跑过。

sentences.en: The next day, we find out there was a shootout just one block over because rival gangs had come over.
sentences.zh: 第二天我们才知道，因为敌对帮派闯入，就在隔壁街区发生了一场枪战。

sentences.en: Three weeks later, one of the kids we were talking to was shot dead by the police in the same place.
sentences.zh: 三周后，我们交谈过的一个孩子在同一个地方被警察枪杀了。

sentences.en: It's a steady drumbeat of violence, but you don't quite know, especially as an outsider, where and when it's going to erupt.
sentences.zh: 暴力事件像鼓点一样持续不断，但作为外来者，你很难确切知道它会在何时何地爆发。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做DJ时，你每天也要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、快闪式的博物馆，陈列着精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: Subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today, and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载《时报》APP，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: So returning to this temporary protected status that arguably helped cause this current violent state in El Salvador,
sentences.zh: 回到这个可以说间接导致了萨尔瓦多当前暴力局势的“临时保护身份”计划，

sentences.en: what has happened with that program since the 1990s when it first started?
sentences.zh: 自20世纪90年代该计划启动以来，它经历了什么？

sentences.en: That initial one was shut down.
sentences.zh: 最初的那项计划被终止了。

sentences.en: They stopped it, I believe, in 1994.
sentences.zh: 我相信是在1994年，他们停止了该计划。

sentences.en: And so refugees leaving from the war could no longer apply for temporary protected status in the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，逃离战争的难民无法再申请美国的临时保护身份。

sentences.en: But as life evolved in El Salvador, more people were deported from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但随着萨尔瓦多局势的发展，更多人被从美国遣返，

sentences.en: and the gangs gained more power on into the 2000s, it remained a very dangerous place.
sentences.zh: 而帮派在21世纪头十年势力大增，那里依然是一个非常危险的地方。

sentences.en: And then in 2001, two earthquakes struck.
sentences.zh: 接着在2001年，发生了两次地震。

sentences.en: USAID called the El Salvador earthquakes the worst disasters in the region in over 50 years.
sentences.zh: 美国国际开发署称萨尔瓦多地震是该地区50多年来最严重的灾难。

sentences.en: And it caused mass devastation through the country and several hundred deaths.
sentences.zh: 它在全国造成了大规模破坏，导致数百人死亡。

sentences.en: And then the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后美国

sentences.en: granted another round of temporary protected status.
sentences.zh: 又批准了新一轮的临时保护身份。

sentences.en: And those are the people we're talking about now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在所谈论的那些人。

sentences.en: Over the years, they have accumulated to 200,000 people.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们的人数累计达到了20万人。

sentences.en: And it continued to be extended.
sentences.zh: 而且该身份一直被延期。

sentences.en: And the argument, at least for the Obama administration, was, well, listen, we've got a country that is being torn apart by violence,
sentences.zh: 至少对奥巴马政府来说，他们的理由是：听着，这个国家正被暴力撕裂，

sentences.en: that has an economy that is suffering, so we'll extend it.
sentences.zh: 经济也在遭受重创，所以我们要延长它。

sentences.en: They sort of expanded the umbrella of what was permitted to keep these guys in the country because the earthquake ceased to be a factor.
sentences.zh: 他们扩大了允许这些人留在国内的范围，因为地震已经不再是主要因素了。

sentences.en: It was no longer that people couldn't return home because their homes were destroyed or because the country was no longer functioning after the earthquakes.
sentences.zh: 人们无法回国不再是因为家园被毁，或者地震后国家陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: But rather, a different menace sort of inhibited them from going home.
sentences.zh: 而是因为另一种威胁阻碍了他们回家。

sentences.en: And that was the violence that we're talking about today.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们今天所谈论的暴力问题。

sentences.en: So the Obama administration was extending the temporary protected status because of the violence there, which was, of course, not the original reason why that status was granted
sentences.zh: 所以奥巴马政府延长临时保护身份是因为当地的暴力问题，这当然不是最初授予该身份的原因，

sentences.en: or why people were fleeing.
sentences.zh: 也不是人们当初逃离的原因。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It was so severe at that point.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况太严重了。

sentences.en: And especially in the later years, it got so bad that...
sentences.zh: 特别是在后期，情况变得如此糟糕，以至于……

sentences.en: Thousands of unaccompanied children are risking their lives to enter the U.S.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的无人陪伴儿童冒着生命危险进入美国，

sentences.en: illegally.
sentences.zh: 非法入境。

sentences.en: Children were showing up at the southern border with the United States.
sentences.zh: 孩子们出现在美国南部边境。

sentences.en: Whole families were showing up at the southern border trying to escape from the gang violence.
sentences.zh: 整个家庭出现在南部边境，试图逃离帮派暴力。

sentences.en: The stream of people seems endless.
sentences.zh: 人流似乎无穷无尽。

sentences.en: Some of the youngest border crossers come with their families, others by themselves.
sentences.zh: 一些最年轻的越境者是随家人来的，另一些则是独自一人。

sentences.en: So these people who arrive in the United States after the earthquakes in 2001, because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些在2001年地震后抵达美国的人，因为美国

sentences.en: government has continued to extend their protected status, in part because of the violence, most of them have never left the United States, right?
sentences.zh: 政府一直延长他们的保护身份，部分原因是暴力问题，他们大多数人从未离开过美国，对吧？

sentences.en: No, they've built lives.
sentences.zh: 不，他们已经在这里建立了生活。

sentences.en: They've built lives, built businesses, raised families, had children who are American citizens.
sentences.zh: 他们建立了生活，创办了企业，养育了家庭，有了身为美国公民的孩子。

sentences.en: They've sort of woven themselves into the fabric of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们已经融入了美国的社会结构之中。

sentences.en: I mean, 2001, we're now in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，2001年到现在已经是2018年了。

sentences.en: We're looking at 17, 18 years of living in one place.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是在同一个地方生活了17、18年。

sentences.en: And during that time, a whole lifetime is lived.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，他们度过了整整一生。

sentences.en: How do you then take 18 years in one place and go back to a country that, especially now, you may not even recognize?
sentences.zh: 你如何能在一个地方生活18年后，再回到一个你可能根本认不出来的国家，尤其是现在？

sentences.en: Right, but it's important to note that it's always been the case that this was a temporary status.
sentences.zh: 没错，但必须指出的是，这始终是一个临时身份。

sentences.en: Temporary, but renewed over and over again.
sentences.zh: 是临时的，但被一次又一次地续期。

sentences.en: It feels like an unusual situation where even though the status was temporary, it started to feel permanent.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一种不同寻常的情况，尽管身份是临时的，但它开始让人感觉是永久的了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, I think people feel it's somewhat cruel to have extended it for so long and then suddenly stopped it.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，我认为人们觉得延长了这么久然后突然停止，这有点残忍。

sentences.en: Whereas before, for instance, when they began in 1990 with Salvadoran's thing, the Civil War, it ended four years later.
sentences.zh: 而之前，例如1990年开始针对萨尔瓦多人的那次，是因为内战，四年后就结束了。

sentences.en: So it was, in fact, temporary.
sentences.zh: 所以它确实是临时的。

sentences.en: Whereas in this case, the years have been allowed to collect.
sentences.zh: 然而在这种情况下，时间却被允许不断累积。

sentences.en: And so, you know, if they'd never been given that, it might not hurt so much to have it taken away.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果他们从未获得过那个身份，现在被取消可能也不会那么痛苦。

sentences.en: But now that they have been given that to take it away is, I think, devastating for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 但既然已经给了他们，现在又收回，我认为这对许多人来说是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: This is such a complicated situation because it seems to me that, by definition, temporary protected status is designed to protect people during temporary periods of crises.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常复杂的情况，因为在我看来，临时保护身份的定义就是为了在临时危机期间保护人们。

sentences.en: And so, arguably, even though the situation in El Salvador has perhaps never been worse,
sentences.zh: 所以可以说，尽管萨尔瓦多的局势可能从未像现在这样糟糕，

sentences.en: and it feels like an unbelievable situation in which to send people back, it's not temporary, really.
sentences.zh: 而且把人送回去感觉简直不可思议，但它确实不再是临时的了。

sentences.en: And therefore, not the responsibility of the United States and this program.
sentences.zh: 因此，这不再是美国和该项目的责任。

sentences.en: I would argue it's not the responsibility of this particular program.
sentences.zh: 我会说这不是这个特定项目的责任。

sentences.en: I wouldn't let the United States off the hook so easily.
sentences.zh: 但我不会轻易让美国推卸责任。

sentences.en: I think the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为美国

sentences.en: has a lot to answer for in El Salvador and in the state that it's in today,
sentences.zh: 对萨尔瓦多及其现状负有很大责任，

sentences.en: in the sort of funding of the Civil War, in the deportation of the people who became gang members in the United States.
sentences.zh: 无论是对内战的资助，还是遣返了那些在美国成为帮派成员的人。

sentences.en: So while temporary protected status, one could very easily and legitimately argue, it no longer applies because the damage from the earthquake no longer applies.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然可以非常容易且合理地争辩说，临时保护身份不再适用，因为地震造成的损害已不复存在。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着美国

sentences.en: doesn't have a responsibility to address some of these issues.
sentences.zh: 没有责任去解决其中的一些问题。

sentences.en: But there is a non-temporary nature to this.
sentences.zh: 但这件事确实具有非临时性的本质。

sentences.en: You're not going to pull people out for three years.
sentences.zh: 你不可能只把人带出来三年。

sentences.en: You can't create a new TPS to help the flood of refugees dealing with violence on the ground because, by most accounts, the violence isn't going to stop in three or four years.
sentences.zh: 你无法建立一个新的TPS来帮助应对暴力问题的难民潮，因为根据大多数人的说法，暴力在三四年内不会停止。

sentences.en: And so there's nothing temporary about it.
sentences.zh: 所以这根本没有什么临时性可言。

sentences.en: What you're describing is kind of a full circle here.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的其实是一个完整的闭环。

sentences.en: The U.S.-backed Civil War arguably created this problem in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 美国支持的内战可以说在萨尔瓦多制造了这个问题。

sentences.en: Then once fleeing Salvadorians reach the United States, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后，当逃离的萨尔瓦多人到达美国后，美国

sentences.en: nurtured gangs and then sent them back to El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 培养了帮派，然后又把他们送回了萨尔瓦多。

sentences.en: And now we are sending people back to the worst realization of that thing we helped start back in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们正在把人们送回我们在90年代帮助开启的那场灾难的最糟糕境地中。

sentences.en: Yeah, the tragedy is that El Salvador today is both an echo and a product of its paSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，悲剧在于今天的萨尔瓦多既是其过去的余响，也是其产物。

sentences.en: I mean, I wouldn't say the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不会说美国

sentences.en: fostered gangs, but the bottom line is the gangs were there.
sentences.zh: 培养了帮派，但底线是帮派就在那里。

sentences.en: And these kids felt that the only option they had was to form those gangs.
sentences.zh: 而这些孩子觉得他们唯一的选择就是加入这些帮派。

sentences.en: And then those kids went back to a country that could barely deal with the problems they were already facing.
sentences.zh: 然后那些孩子回到了一个几乎无法应对他们所面临问题的国家。

sentences.en: And yeah, now you've got 200,000 more people who had fled El Salvador going back into the same kind of dire conditions at the behest of an American government.
sentences.zh: 是的，现在你有20万逃离萨尔瓦多的人，在美方政府的要求下，又回到了同样可怕的境地。

sentences.en: Thank you, Azam.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，阿扎姆。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: The Temporary Protected Status Program provides lawful status and authorization to work to people from countries affected by armed conflict, natural disaster, or other crises,
sentences.zh: 临时保护身份计划为受武装冲突、自然灾害或其他危机影响的国家的人们提供合法身份和工作许可，

sentences.en: whether they entered the United States legally or not.
sentences.zh: 无论他们是否合法进入美国。

sentences.en: By ending the program for Salvadorans on Monday, the Trump administration will no longer protect members of the group from deportation.
sentences.zh: 随着周一结束对萨尔瓦多人的该计划，特朗普政府将不再保护该群体成员免受遣返。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Times is reporting that Special Counsel Robert Mueller has told White House lawyers he will likely seek to interview the president,
sentences.zh: 据《时报》报道，特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒已告知白宫律师，他很可能会寻求对总统进行问话，

sentences.en: though no formal request has been made and no date has been set.
sentences.zh: 尽管目前尚未提出正式请求，也没有确定日期。

sentences.en: White House officials see the request as a sign that the investigation may be nearing an end and are expected to set ground rules for the interview.
sentences.zh: 白宫官员将此请求视为调查可能接近尾声的信号，预计将为问话设定基本规则。

sentences.en: If the president refuses to cooperate, Mueller could respond with a grand jury subpoena.
sentences.zh: 如果总统拒绝配合，穆勒可能会以大陪审团传票作为回应。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday night, North Korea agreed to send athletes to the Winter Olympics in South Korea,
sentences.zh: 周二晚间，朝鲜同意派遣运动员参加在韩国举行的冬奥会，

sentences.en: a symbolic breakthrough after months of escalating tensions over the North's rapidly advancing nuclear and missile prograMs.
sentences.zh: 这是在朝鲜核导计划迅速推进导致数月紧张局势升级后的一个象征性突破。

sentences.en: In talks held in a border village, North Korea is reported to have quickly accepted the South's request that they send a large delegation to the Games,
sentences.zh: 据报道，在边境村庄举行的会谈中，朝鲜迅速接受了韩国提出的派遣大规模代表团参加奥运会的请求，

sentences.en: marking the first time in eight years that North Korea will have participated in the Winter Olympics.
sentences.zh: 这是朝鲜八年来首次参加冬奥会。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。
